claim: The sample demo stays separate from the visitor's real log.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; assert the demo IndexedDB exists and the real database does not

claim: A customer can return a matching acknowledgement that persists in the local log.
where: first screen, How it works, README
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; open the bike change card, create its receipt, import it, reload, and assert Confirmed

claim: Customer contacts stay on the device, never enter shared card links, and are not sent automatically.
where: first-screen facts, form, history, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh /demo sample with network interception; decode a card and assert contact fields are absent and all HTTP requests are same-origin

claim: The saved log opens offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; wait for service-worker control, go offline, reload, and assert the sample record and offline status

claim: The free tools export every local record as JSON and CSV.
where: data tools, privacy page, terms, README
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; download both formats and assert three records plus one CSV header

claim: The form imports the first event from an ICS calendar file.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; upload a bundled in-memory ICS event and assert its title, time, and location populate

claim: A valid JSON backup can replace the local log after confirmation.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; import one complete record, accept the specific replacement prompt, and assert exactly that record remains

claim: Expired change cards cannot create acknowledgement receipts.
where: change form, customer card, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; construct the same private card with a past expiry and assert acknowledgement is unavailable

claim: Move Confirmed Plus costs $29 once and saves reusable business defaults and a message template.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample using its Plus preview; assert price, no subscription, save a demo-only default, reload, and assert demo persistence
